salt-grain.name: klayout_em_export
salt-grain.title: RFIC EM export: layouts to Palace and openEMS EM models
salt-grain.doc: Exports part of a layout for EM simulation with Palace (gds2palace) or openEMS (gds2openEMS): a flat GDS with only the layers of the stackup and the ports, plus a settings file (.simcfg) for setupEM. Replaces transistors and resistors by ports at their pins and puts the PDK devices back around the EM result (Create Circuit); large regions can be split into pieces with calibrated port walls at the cuts. Needs setupEM and snp2le from pip (pip install setupEM snp2le). Menu: EM (in the menu bar), panel: EM Panel. Examples: the examples folder of the package.
salt-grain.author: Volker Muehlhaus
